items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch erhoben werden.
items.computation: The Bescheid is dated Fri 27.02.2026 and the letter states it was posted (zur Post gegeben) that same day. Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO a letter posted domestically counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Tue 03.03.2026. Under § 108 Abs. 1 AO / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 AO) starts running on 04.03.2026. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a one-month period ends on the day of the last month bearing the same number as the start day of the event, i.e. Fri 03.04.2026. Since 03.04.2026 (Karfreitag) is a public holiday in Hessen (and nationwide), under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deadline shifts to the next working day, Tue 07.04.2026.

warnings: This assessment results in a refund of 550,00 € to be credited to the taxpayer's account on file; the letter names no date for this credit, so no due date was set for it.

The IBAN printed in the footer belongs to the Finanzamt itself (for outgoing refunds/for paying any tax owed) and is well-formed, but this letter sets no payment obligation for the recipient — it is a refund, so no money needs to be sent.
